verdict.rationale: Only a single generic marketing line claims incident management 'from Slack,' with no documentation of Teams support, automatic channel creation, role assignment, or update posting via chat commands. Related items about Slack data feeding Post-Incident Reviews don't address declaring/running an incident from chat itself. Missing for 10: explicit Teams integration, chat slash-command/declare workflow details, automatic channel/role creation evidence, and any hands-on or community confirmation of this specific chat-driven flow.
